name: Linux
description: The Sumo Logic App for Linux contains dashboards and searches that watch Linux server events and machine health, including root activity, system events, and user activity.

panels.name: Total Event Distribution
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* 
| parse regex "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s(?<process_name>\w*)(?:\[\d+\]|):\s+" 
| count as Events by dest_hostname

panels.name: Event Count per Host by Hour
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* 
| parse regex "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s(?<process_name>\w*)(?:\[\d+\]|):\s+" 
| timeslice 1h | count  as Events  by dest_hostname,_timeslice|  sort by -Events 
| transpose row _timeslice column dest_hostname

panels.name: Event Count by Host and Service
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/*
| parse regex "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s(?<process_name>\w+)(?:\[\d+\]|):\s+" 
| where process_name !=""
| dest_hostname as host 
| count as events by process_name,host 
| transpose row host column process_name

panels.name: Reporting Hosts by Hour
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* 
| parse regex "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s(?<process_name>\w*)(?:\[\d+\]|):\s+" 
| timeslice 1h | count by dest_hostname,_timeslice| count(dest_hostname) as Hosts by _timeslice  | sort by -_timeslice

panels.name: Logins by Hour
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* ("sshd:" or "sshd[" or "pam:" ) (("Accepted" and "pam") or "session" or ("to" and "on") or ("authentication failure" or "FAILED SU") ) !"closed"
| parse regex "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s(?<process_name>\w*):\s+(?<message>.*)$" nodrop
| parse regex  "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s(?<process_name>\S*)\[\d+\]:\s+(?<message>.*)$" nodrop
| if (message matches "*failure;*" or message matches "*FAILED *","Failure","Success") as outcome
| timeslice 1h |  count by outcome,_timeslice | sort -_timeslice | transpose row _timeslice column outcome as %"Success", %"Failure"

panels.name: Top 30 Successful User Logins
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* ("su:" or "sudo:" or "sshd:" or "sshd[" or "pam:") (("Accepted" and "pam") or "session" or ("to" and "on")) !"closed"
| parse regex "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s(?<process_name>\w*):\s+(?<message>.*)$" nodrop
| parse regex  "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s(?<process_name>\S*)\[\d+\]:\s+(?<message>.*)$" nodrop
| parse "session * for user * by *(uid=*)" as (action,dest_user,src_user,src_user_id) nodrop
| parse regex "session (?<action>\w*) for user (?<dest_user>\S*)" nodrop
| parse "Accepted keyboard-interactive/pam for * from * port * *" as (dest_user,src_hostname,src_port,protocol)
| where dest_user!=""
| count as count by dest_user,dest_hostname | sort by -count | limit 30

panels.name: Top 30 Failed Logins
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* ("authentication failure" or "FAILED SU")
| parse regex "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s" nodrop
| parse "ruser=* rhost=* user=*" as src_user,src_hostname, dest_user nodrop
| parse "Authentication failure for * from *" as dest_user,src_hostname nodrop
| parse "FAILED SU (to *) * on" as dest_user,src_user nodrop
| parse regex "FAILED LOGIN (?:SESSION|\d+) FROM (?<src_tty>\S+) FOR (?<dest_user>\S+)," nodrop
| where dest_user!=""  
| count as Attempts by src_hostname, dest_user, dest_hostname | sort - Attempts | limit 30

panels.name: Failed Logins per Host by Hour
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* ("authentication failure" or "FAILED SU")
| parse regex "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s" nodrop
| parse "ruser=* rhost=* user=*" as src_user,src_hostname, dest_user nodrop
| parse "Authentication failure for * from *" as dest_user,src_hostname nodrop
| parse "FAILED SU (to *) * on" as dest_user,src_user nodrop
| parse regex "FAILED LOGIN (?:SESSION|\d+) FROM (?<src_tty>\S+) FOR (?<dest_user>\S+)," nodrop
| timeslice 1h 
| where dest_user!=""  
| count by dest_hostname,_timeslice   | sort by -_timeslice | transpose row _timeslice column dest_hostname

panels.name: Top 30 Successful Remote Logins
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* ("sshd:" or "sshd[" or "pam:") (("Accepted" and "pam") or "session" or ("to" and "on")) !"closed"
| parse regex "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s(?<process_name>\w*):\s+(?<message>.*)$" nodrop
| parse regex  "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s(?<process_name>\S*)\[\d+\]:\s+(?<message>.*)$" nodrop
| parse "session * for user * by *(uid=*)" as (action,dest_user,src_user,src_user_id) nodrop
| parse regex "session (?<action>\w*) for user (?<dest_user>\S*)" nodrop
| where dest_user!=""
| count as count by dest_user,dest_hostname | sort - count | limit 30

panels.name: Top 30 Failed Remote Logins

| parse "ruser=* rhost=* user=*" as src_user,src_hostname, dest_user nodrop

panels.name: Logins by Outcome
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* ("sshd:" or "sshd[" or "pam:" ) (("Accepted" and "pam") or "session" or ("to" and "on") or ("authentication failure" or "FAILED SU") ) !"closed"
| parse regex "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s(?<process_name>\w*):\s+(?<message>.*)$" nodrop
| parse regex  "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s(?<process_name>\S*)\[\d+\]:\s+(?<message>.*)$" nodrop
| if (message matches "*failure;*" or message matches "*FAILED *","Failure","Success") as outcome
| count by outcome

panels.name: Sudo Attempts
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* "sudo"
| parse "PWD=* ;" as working_dir
| count by working_dir
| where _count > 100

panels.name: User Assignments
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* ("to group" or "default group changed" or "change user") or ("useradd" and (("new user") or ("new account")))
| parse "add '*' to group '*'" as dest_user,dest_group nodrop
| parse "account added to group - account=*, group=*, gid=*," as dest_user,dest_group,dest_gid nodrop
| parse "account=*, uid=*, gid=*, old gid=*," as dest_user,dest_uid, dest_gid,src_gid nodrop
| parse "change user '*' GID from '*' to '*'" as dest_user,src_gid, dest_gid nodrop
| parse "name=*, UID=*, GID=*, home=*, shell=*" as dest_user,dest_uid,dest_gid,home_dir,shell nodrop
| parse "account=*, uid=*, gid=*, home=*, shell=*," as dest_user,dest_uid,dest_gid,home_dir,shell nodrop
| if(dest_group="" or isNull(dest_group), dest_gid, dest_group) as dest_group
| count_distinct(dest_user) by dest_group
| sum(_count_distinct)

panels.name: Reporting Hosts
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* 
| parse regex "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s(?<process_name>\w*)(?:\[\d+\]|):\s+" 
| count_distinct(dest_hostname) as _hostCount

panels.name: Failed SU Attempts
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* ("authentication failure" or "FAILED SU") ("su:" or "su[")
| parse regex "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s" nodrop
| parse "ruser=* rhost=* user=*" as src_user,src_hostname, dest_user nodrop
| parse "Authentication failure for * from *" as dest_user,src_hostname nodrop
| parse "FAILED SU (to *) * on" as dest_user,src_user  nodrop
| parse "FAILED su for * by *" as dest_user,src_user  nodrop
| where dest_user!="" and src_user!=""
| count as attempts by dest_hostname, src_user, dest_user | sort - attempts

panels.name: New User Assignments
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* "useradd" and (("new user") or ("new account"))
| parse regex "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s(?<process_name>\w*)(?:\[|:)" nodrop
| parse "name=*, UID=*, GID=*, home=*, shell=*" as dest_user,dest_uid,dest_gid,home_dir,shell nodrop
| parse "account=*, uid=*, gid=*, home=*, shell=*," as dest_user,dest_uid,dest_gid,home_dir,shell nodrop 
| timeslice 1h | count by dest_hostname,_timeslice | sort - _timeslice  | transpose row _timeslice column dest_hostname as *

panels.name: Package Operations
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* ("installed" or "erased" or "remove" or "<install>" or "<uninstall>") NOT "MTA"
| parse regex "\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s+status\s+(?<action>installed)\s+(?<pkg_name>\S*)\s+" nodrop
| parse regex "\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s+(?<action>remove)\s+(?<pkg_name>[^ ]*)\s" nodrop
| parse regex "\S*\s+\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s+(?<action>\w*):\s(?<pkg_name>[^ ]*)\s" nodrop
| parse regex "<(?<action>[a-zA-Z]*)>\s+[^\(\)]*\(\d+\)(?<pkg_name>[^\(]*)\(" nodrop
| if (action in ("Installed","install"), "installed",action) as action
| if (action in ("uninstall","erased","remove"), "uninstalled",action) as action
| _sourceHost as sourceHost
| where action!=""
| count by sourceHost,action | transpose row sourceHost column action as *

panels.name: Sudo Attempts
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* "sudo"
| parse regex "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s" nodrop
| extract "sudo:\s+(?<src_user>[^ ]+?)\s:.+?USER=(?<dest_user>[^ ]+?)\s+"  nodrop
| parse regex "COMMAND=(?<command>[^$]*)$" nodrop
| where command !=""
| count as attempts by dest_hostname,src_user,dest_user, command | sort - attempts

panels.name: Existing User Assignments
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* "to group" or "default group changed" or "change user"
| parse regex "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s(?<process_name>\w*)(?:\[|:)" nodrop
| parse "add '*' to group '*'" as dest_user,dest_group nodrop
| parse "account added to group - account=*, group=*, gid=*," as dest_user,dest_group,dest_gid nodrop
| parse "account=*, uid=*, gid=*, old gid=*," as dest_user,dest_uid, dest_gid,src_gid nodrop
| parse "change user '*' GID from '*' to '*'" as dest_user,src_gid, dest_gid
| where dest_gid in("10","0","4") or dest_group in ("root", "wheel", "adm")  
| timeslice 1h | count by dest_hostname,_timeslice | sort -_timeslice | transpose row _timeslice column dest_hostname as *

panels.name: System Starts
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* "Initializing cgroup subsys cpuset"
| parse regex "^(?<StartTime>\S*\s+\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+)\s(?<dest_hostname>\S*)\s(?<process_name>\w*)(?:\[\d+\]|):\s+" nodrop
| count by dest_hostname,process_name,StartTime,_messagetime | sort by _messagetime | fields - _count,_messagetime
